<function name="CapabilitiesAdd" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<description>Adds a capability to the NPC.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="capabilities" type="number{CAP}">Capabilities to add, see <page>Enums/CAP</page>.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Adds the `CAP_USE_SHOT_REGULATOR` to the NPC's capabilities.</description>
	<code>self:CapabilitiesAdd( CAP_USE_SHOT_REGULATOR )</code>
</example>
